system.description: The Jedi focuses on those around them, mentally highlighting each opponent. At the beginning of an encounter, you may roll a DC 20 Use the Force check. If successful, you may adjust your Initiative Count by up to +5 or down to -5.

prerequisite.text: Force Intuition (Jedi Guardian Talent Tree) talent
